responsibility: Defines the generated-facing C enum and helper macros for C-SKY ISA feature bits. By re-including csky_isa.def, it turns the declarative ISA list into enum constants and feature-list construction macros such as CSKY_ISA_FEATURE_GET and CSKY_ISA_FEAT, providing the typed representation that other target headers and option tables use to encode and query architectural capabilities.
same_name_distinction: This is the C header that turns the declarative ISA list into concrete programmatic interfaces by including csky_isa.def to build enum csky_isa_feature values and helper macros like CSKY_ISA_FEATURE_GET and CSKY_ISA_FEAT. Unlike csky_isa.def, which is only the reusable feature/macro definition list, this file provides the compiled header form consumed by other C-SKY backend code.
